description: Fetch every stored fact for one project: developer, area, starting price, handover, ownership, DLD fee, payment plan, unit mix, amenities, distances, FAQ and description. Accepts a slug or a project name.

lang.description: Language of the answer. Default en.

name.description: Project name e.g. "Radisson Blu by RAK". Used when the slug is unknown.

name: get_project_details
title: One project in full
